fingerprint_contract: NFC-normalized, whitespace-collapsed, case-preserving path + rule_id + surface_kind + evidence; policy_release omitted

LANG001_UNPAIRED_PROHIBITION.help: Lead with the state to preserve, then name the hard boundary and the safe behavior collaborators can perform.
LANG001_UNPAIRED_PROHIBITION.message: Instruction names a prohibition without an affirmative target and replacement behavior in the same logical paragraph.

LANG002_NEGATIVE_IDENTIFIER.help: Name the state or capability the implementation provides.
LANG002_NEGATIVE_IDENTIFIER.message: Identifier names blocked behavior rather than a desired capability.

LANG003_UNVERIFIABLE_TARGET.help: Name the check, evidence, receipt, metric, or review that verifies it.
LANG003_UNVERIFIABLE_TARGET.message: High-consequence target or boundary lacks an observable verification method in the same logical paragraph.

LANG900_PARSE_FAILURE.help: Repair the source so every applicable surface can be inspected.
LANG900_PARSE_FAILURE.message: Authored content could not be parsed by the bounded reader.

LANG901_EXEMPTION_INVALID.help: Use a reviewed, exact, time-bounded exemption or remove stale policy.
LANG901_EXEMPTION_INVALID.message: A language-policy exemption is invalid, expired, or unused.
